author: NileBlue
description:
Ok so we just finished panning for gold using a bunch that Reggie bought off the internet, and by some miracle, we were actually able to get some gold.

That being said, I don't know why, but I've always assumed that gold is pure (24k) when found in nature, but that might not really be the case. So we and to use the XRF gun to find out how pure this gold actually is.

#shorts
title: Testing the purity of gold from dirt
